2 Games in 1 - Findet Nemo + Die Unglaub.name: 2 Games in 1: Finding Nemo + The Incredibles
2 Games in 1 - Findet Nemo + Die Unglaub.summary: A compilation of Pixar themed games on a single cartridge.

2 in 1 Game Pack - Shrek 2 + Shark Tale.name: 2 in 1 Game Pack: DreamWorks' Shark Tale + Shrek 2
2 in 1 Game Pack - Shrek 2 + Shark Tale.summary: A compilation of two games based on DreamWorks animated movies on a single cartridge.

BMX Trick Racer.name: BMX Trick Racer
BMX Trick Racer.summary: Gamers race and rip tricks on 15 street and dirt tracks in unique BMX environments that go through cities, jungles, deserts, mountains, snow and ice. The goal is to rack up as many points as possible with real BMX tricks and a few unreal ones while facing obstacles you won?t find in other BMX games such as ramps, springs and collapsing bridges. In single-player mode, gamers compete against five other bikers who push you to the limit to race like a pro.

Duel Masters - Shadow of the Code.name: Duel Masters: Shadow of the Code
Duel Masters - Shadow of the Code.summary: The third game based on the DUEL MASTERS anime. Gamers will get back in the card-game dueling with access to all 600 released cards, an in-depth storyline featuring characters from the anime, and more.

Frogger's Adventures - Temple of the Fro.name: Frogger's Adventures: Temple of the Frog
Frogger's Adventures - Temple of the Fro.summary: Firefly Swamp is dying and the frogs from the Elder Council have asked Frogger to save it! To do so, Frogger must undertake a grueling quest to collect the sacred elements needed to keep the swamp alive. These elements have been stolen by the evil Mr. D and have been spread throughout four perilous worlds. Frogger must travel to each world retrieve the stolen elements and defeat Mr. D's evil henchmen. Then and only then will he be able to enter the Temple of the Frog to face the treacherous Mr. D.

Nobunaga Ibun.name: Nobunaga Ibun
Nobunaga Ibun.summary: Nobunaga Ibun is a Strategy game, published by Global A, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Shanghai Advance.name: Shanghai Advance
Shanghai Advance.summary: Shanghai Advance is a Puzzle game, published by SunSoft, which was released in Japan in 2001.
